records.text: Candace Owens said a debit-card receipt placed Tyler Robinson at a Panguitch restaurant at 9:47 p.m., about three hours from Orem.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: He concluded and paid at 9.47 p.m. There's a literal receipt for that because, as we said. He paid with his debit card so we can timestamp him three hours away at 9.47 p.m. when he's apparently texting Lance (Lance Twiggs).

verification.notes: The transcript supplies Owens’s claimed receipt time, but live searches of the current hearing transcripts, official filing, and authoritative current coverage did not locate the receipt or independently confirm a 9:47 p.m. Panguitch card transaction. The private or unpublicized exhibit cannot be treated as verified.

records.text: Candace Owens argued that Tyler Robinson could not have been monitoring the Utah Valley University campus after 11 p.m. if he left Panguitch near 10 p.m., and said the text-message timeline required timestamps.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: If at nearly 10 p.m. he's leaving Panguitch, he couldn't have been babysitting the campus. This is the problem. The messages are problematic and that's why they're not time stamped.

verification.notes: The travel-time inference depends on the unverified 9:47 p.m. Panguitch receipt and on missing message timestamps. Without authenticated timestamps and a confirmed departure point, the claimed impossibility cannot be resolved. The request for timestamps is reasonable but is not itself proof of the conclusion.

records.text: Owens said the FBI knew of the Panguitch restaurant lead and took a statement from the owner; she also said she spoke to the owner, the server gave an interview, and a debit-card receipt existed.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: I don't know how many times I can say this. I guess I'm going to basically say to them what I said to Andrew face to face is you can keep saying this. You're going to eventually embarrass yourself. As I said, they got in touch with the FBI. ... The FBI is aware of this. The FBI took a statement from the owner. I spoke to the. ... But I spoke to the owner. The server has given an interview. There is a receipt. ... this was found this Panguitch thing was actually found by podcasters podcasters who were investigating stumbled upon this and like i said the fbi was contacted there is a report made it happened

verification.notes: Current on-location citizen reporting publishes a receipt, a recorded owner interview, and a recorded server interview. The owner says he gave the FBI everything he had, and staff describe contacting the FBI; the receipt is a debit transaction but contains no customer name and has not been authenticated by a court. These sources support that a restaurant lead, server interview, and debit receipt exist, but there is no public official FBI confirmation that it took the owner's statement, and Owens' own conversation with the owner is not independently documented.
